declarations.what_was_read: Every printed entry of all four lists in the Genealogy Trails publication of Ingrid Latimer Schulz's IRAD transcription — 345 entries, in order, each carrying the line of data/research/civic/text/voter_lists_1833_1835.txt it stands on.
what_was_not_read: the IRAD originals themselves, which nobody in this project has seen
the Chicago Genealogist XXV/4 (Summer 1993) printing, which is the transcription's own publication and is not held here
anything the lists do not print: no age, no trade, no address, no lot
declarations.note: T-0493 stated 346 entries and 215 distinct surnames. The deposit prints 345 and 214, and so does the live Genealogy Trails page: the 1833 poll list is 30 entries, not 31, and the supplied PDF agrees. The lower figure is the measured one.

declarations.what_was_read: Every printed row of the Illinois State Archives index of Black Hawk War veterans who enrolled at Chicago, as republished by the Genealogy Trails Transcription Team — 134 rows, header excluded, in order, each with its five cells taken from the cached page and each carrying the line of data/research/civic/text/blackhawk_war_1832_chicago.txt it stands on.
what_was_not_read: Ellen M. Whitney's volume itself, which nobody in this project has seen and which is where the dates of enrollment and the remarks on service are printed
the Illinois State Archives database in its own interface — the layer read is the Genealogy Trails republication of it
the rest of the site's Military Records section, which is 1861 and later
anything the index does not print: no date within 1832, no residence, no address, no age, no trade, no household
declarations.note: The count is the acceptance: 134 rows, and tools/read_blackhawk_war.py --check fails if the reading holds any other number, if the 83 comma-less names stop being carried, or if this declaration and the reading disagree. 83 of 134 names carry no surname comma — the French and Potawatomi forms — and a reader who filters on the comma drops exactly the part of the town this reconstruction is least able to lose.
